受够了走路晃一下手机就「摇一摇」跳进购物页？刚聊完什么马上满屏推同款广告？查个资料满屏悬浮牛皮癣弹窗、强迫打开 App 才给看全文？

【净盾 CleanShield】用一套 100% 纯设备本地离线的工具箱，一次还你清爽安静的手机体验：

1. 【隐私与防摇一摇关停体检台】
• 一步一路径带打勾进度条：手把手带你切断传感器误触跳转、关闭跨应用追踪、封堵后台偷读剪贴板与系统隐藏「重要地点」记录。
• 覆盖 30 项系统与高频日常软件深藏的个性化广告入口，支持一键复制搜索词与「180 天到期重关本地提醒」，告别半年后精准广告悄悄复活。

2. 【零权限 Safari 网页净盾 + 26 项民生免误杀铁白名单】
• 采用 Apple 官方原生静态过滤引擎（SFContentBlocker），绝不申请「读取网页密码与信用卡信息」高危权限，连开发者也无法知晓您访问过任何网页。
• 出厂底层锁死导航地图、四大行、运营商与移动支付白名单，只拦牛皮癣弹窗与第三方追踪器，日常应用 100% 流畅不断网。

3. 【发原图前 · 一键抹除照片 GPS 定位与拍摄隐私】
• 发原图或传网盘前，1 秒检测照片内隐藏的精确家庭经纬度坐标、海拔与手机镜头型号，纯本地内存一键生成无定位干净副本。

4. 【桌面一步直达小组件】
• 长按主屏幕添加「净盾」小组件，跳过繁杂首页信息流，一步呼出扫一扫、付款码、乘车码与纯净搜索。

en-US.name: CleanShield: AdBlock & Privacy
en-US.subtitle: Stop Trackers, Popups & EXIF
en-US.promotionalText: 100% Offline Privacy Suite: Declarative Safari Content Blocker (zero password-read permission), 30-point hidden ad/sensor audit checklist, and 1-tap Photo GPS/EXIF scrubber.
en-US.description:
Tired of intrusive web banners, creepy cross-app ad retargeting, hidden motion-sensor redirects, and photos leaking your exact home GPS coordinates?

CleanShield combines four 100% offline, on-device privacy defenses in one lightweight utility:

1. Zero-Permission Safari Web Shield
• Built on Apple's native declarative SFContentBlocker API—blocks annoying banners, popups, and third-party analytics trackers without ever requesting permission to read your passwords, credit cards, or browsing history.
• Includes a built-in 26-domain Safe Whitelist (Maps, Banking, Carriers, Payments) evaluated last via ignore-previous-rules so essential services never break.

2. 30-Point Privacy & Hidden Ad Switch Audit
• Step-by-step interactive checklist to lock down motion sensors, cross-app tracking (ATT), silent clipboard snooping, Significant Locations, and deeply buried ad personalization toggles—complete with 180-day local reset reminders.

3. Instant Photo GPS & EXIF Metadata Scrubber
• Inspect hidden latitude/longitude, timestamp, and camera lens tags before sharing original photos, and save a clean metadata-free copy in one tap.

4. Clean Direct-Launch Home Screen Widgets
• Jump straight to QR scanners, payment passes, and tracker-free search right from your Home Screen.

Subscriptions & Lifetime Unlock:
Core audit checks, base Safari ad/tracker blocking, and single-photo GPS scrubbing are free forever with zero ads. Upgrade to CleanShield Pro via Monthly ($0.99/mo), Yearly ($3.99/yr), or One-Time Lifetime Unlock ($6.99). Auto-renewing subscriptions can be cancelled anytime at least 24 hours before renewal in Apple Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/clean-shield/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://a3152557994-ship-it.github.io/clean-shield/terms.html
